description: Open-LIFU transmitter (TX) module application firmware for STM32L443: TX7332 AFE configuration, trigger, thermistor and thermal limits, module manager (I2C master/slave, one-wire discovery), presets (FDA images); binary command protocol over USB CDC. Runs from the secure bootloader's slot (0x08010400) and enters the bootloader's DFU on request.

components.name: STM32Cube MCU Package for STM32L4 (FW_L4)
components.description: STM32Cube package the HAL, CMSIS device files and middleware were generated from. The HAL / CMSIS versions actually in the tree are derived separately.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: lifu-transmitter-fw.ioc: ProjectManager.FirmwarePackage=STM32Cube FW_L4 V1.18.2. HAL v1.13.6 and CMSIS Device L4 v1.7.5 in the tree are the versions STM32CubeL4 v1.18.2 pins (identical to open-lifu-transmitter-bl's, checked 2026-11-17); the USB Device Library is one release newer than the pack (v2.11.6, see that component).

components.name: STM32 USB Device Library (Core + CDC class)
components.description: USB device stack and CDC (virtual COM port) class carrying the host command protocol. Byte-identical to upstream v2.11.6 (no local changes).

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: Core/ and Class/CDC/ diffed against upstream tag v2.11.6 on 2026-11-17. Core updated from v2.11.5 (the STM32CubeL4 v1.18.2 pin) to v2.11.6 for the usbd_ctlreq.c fixes (USBD_StdEPReq endpoint index > 15 rejected; USBD_GetString bounded); the CDC class was already identical to v2.11.6.

properties.name: openwater:version-correction
properties.value: the hand-written SBOM listed 1.18.2, which is the FW_L4 package version, not the library version
